payload.summary: PLAN_REVIEW reached the configured third-attempt limit without convergence. The primary review found seven critical lifecycle and merge-routing blockers plus two nits and two positive observations. The recorded vendor manifest has no valid external review (Antigravity, Claude, Grok, and Pi all failed), so the synthesized single-vendor artifact is non-quorate; its automatic zero-blocking/accept recommendations must not override the seven primary critical findings.
completed_work: Read proposal, design, tasks, all delta specs, contracts, and work-packages.yaml after Plan Iteration 3.
Wrote and schema-validated 11 Codex findings: 7 critical, 2 nit, and 2 positive observations.
Attempted multi-vendor dispatch and used the recorded review-manifest.json participation evidence: Antigravity, Claude, Grok, and Pi produced no valid findings.
Synthesized consensus-plan.json from the only valid review; external quorum was not met and all findings remain unconfirmed by another vendor.
Applied the configured max-phase-iterations policy after the third PLAN_REVIEW attempt.

decisions.title: Plan review exhausted without convergence
decisions.rationale: Live same-token resume can create two valid writers; durability refs are unavailable to expired acquire; process evidence can collide across entries; legacy unleased state bypasses safety assessment; recovery adoption can race a live old writer; post-ESCALATE teardown has no resume transition; and operator overrides are not constrained to ambiguous classifications.

next_steps: Bind live lease retry/resume to controller identity and rotate the fence only after stale-process proof; reject duplicate live resume.
Persist or require the exact durability ref for takeover, including parent-feature refs for integrated package worktrees.
Scope process-evidence keys to the registry entry plus lease or enforce registry-wide unique strong lease ids.
Run the full safety assessment before acquiring pre-existing unleased/legacy entries and before recovery adoption; quarantine live or indeterminate process evidence.
Define autopilot resume after clean teardown by recreating the durable branch/worktree and issuing a new fenced lease.
Allow operator delivery overrides only for an ambiguous latest classification and specify canonical classification digest serialization.
Add the missing Ruff format-check gate, then request operator disposition because PLAN_REVIEW has reached max iterations.
